step1_analysis.circuit_type: Class-AB Push-Pull Output Stage with Replica
step1_analysis.description: This circuit is a push-pull output stage (XMP, XMN) equipped with a scaled replica (XMPS, XMNS). It is used to drive the output load while the replica senses the output current for a buffered switching Class-AB bias scheme.

paper_reference.title: A 105dB-Gain 500MHz-Bandwidth 0.1Ω-OutputImpedance Amplifier for an Amplitude Modulator in 65nm CMOS

dc_gain.description: Open-loop low-frequency voltage gain of the main push-pull stage.

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming Vbias_n=0.52V and Vbias_p=1.15V for balanced ~13uA current: Gm_n = 2*Id/Vov_n = 270uS, Gm_p = 115uS. Total Gm = 385uS. Rout = ro_n || ro_p = 740k || 757k = 374kOhm. Gain = Gm * Rout = 144 V/V = 43 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The 105dB reported in the paper is for the entire multi-stage amplifier. This isolated output stage provides moderate open-loop gain.

bandwidth.description: -3dB bandwidth of the open-loop stage with a 1pF load.

sky130_expected.calculation: BW = 1 / (2 * pi * Rout * C_load) = 1 / (2 * pi * 374k * 1p) = 425 kHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Open-loop bandwidth is determined by the high output impedance and load capacitance. The 500MHz reported is the closed-loop bandwidth of the full amplifier.
The 0.1 ohm reported is achieved via global negative feedback. The open-loop output impedance is simply the parallel combination of the transistors' output resistances.

quiescent_power.description: DC power consumption of the output stage and replica at zero AC input.

sky130_expected.calculation: Id_n ~ 13.5uA, Id_p ~ 13.2uA. Total current for main and replica is ~27uA. Power = 1.8V * 27uA = 48.6 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the chosen bias voltages to keep both NMOS and PMOS in saturation (Class-AB) and SKY130 parameters.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure open-loop DC gain, -3dB bandwidth, output impedance, and quiescent power of the Class-AB output stage.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Class-AB Output Stage Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xmps=5u L_xmps=0.5u
.param W_xmp=5u L_xmp=0.5u
.param W_xmn=5u L_xmn=0.5u
.param W_xmns=5u L_xmns=0.5u

XMPS VOS N4 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmps} w={W_xmps}
XMP VO N4 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmp} w={W_xmp}
XMN VO N1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmn} w={W_xmn}
XMNS VOS N1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmns} w={W_xmns}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8

* Biasing for Class-AB operation
Vbias_n N1_bias 0 0.52
Vbias_p N4_bias 0 1.15

* AC Input
Vin in 0 dc 0 ac 1
E_n N1 N1_bias in 0 1
E_p N4 N4_bias in 0 1

* DC operating point forcing (large inductor) and load capacitor
V_VO_bias VO_bias 0 0.9
L_bias VO_bias VO 1000H
C_load VO 0 1p

V_VOS_bias VOS_bias 0 0.9
L_bias_s VOS_bias VOS 1000H
C_load_s VOS 0 1p

* AC Current source for Rout measurement (inactive initially)
Iout 0 VO dc 0 ac 0

.control
* 1. DC Operating Point
op
let pwr = -i(VVDD)*1.8
print pwr

* 2. AC Analysis for Gain and Bandwidth
ac dec 100 10 10G
let gain_db = vdb(VO)
meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=100
let gain_3db = dc_gain - 3
meas ac bw when gain_db=gain_3db fall=1

let gain_vos_db = vdb(VOS)
meas ac dc_gain_vos find gain_vos_db at=100

* 3. AC Analysis for Output Impedance
alter Vin ac=0
alter Iout ac=1
ac dec 10 10 10G
let vout_mag = mag(v(VO))
meas ac rout_val find vout_mag at=100

print dc_gain bw rout_val dc_gain_vos
quit
.endc
